batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b SR Watson

balls.text: Mathews is full once more, Binny tries to hammer it over long-on, but edges it just behind the stumps for a single
Mathews keeps it full, squeezed out towards extra cover for a single
full and on middle, driven towards long-on, not too well timed giving the batsmen time to take two
what a shot from Botha first up, a full toss around leg stump, reverse-paddled past short third man for four, ingenious

the yorker from Mathews does the job, Rahane has no answer to that, he made room and was looking to carve it through the off, he misses and the ball thuds into the stumps, some spot-on yorkers from Pune today
pitched up and that is drilled towards long-off for a single

drops it short, Binny goes for the pull, top-edges it towards Bhuvneshwar Kumar at short fine leg, Bhuvneshwar has to race towards the rope to try get under that but it lands about a yard ahead of hime, batsmen take three and Nehra finishes with excellent figures of 3-20
full and just outside leg stump, Rahane can only push it towards long-on for a single
full and outside off, crisply struck towards long-off for a single
looks to guide this down to third man but misses
overpitched and just outside leg, Hodge looks to thump that over the leg side but can only send it as far as Ganguly as midwicket
full and that is clipped towards midwicket, Ganguly fields
more powerfully hit this time from Hodge, making room and carving a length ball towards sweeper cover, can't get his placement right though, so he can't find the rope
a full toss on leg stump, Rahane presents a straight bat, lofting it over the bowler's head, not too powerfully hit though, long-on can come around
full and angling across, Rahane can't get bat on that as he looks to push that towards cover
poor delivery that, slanting down the pads, fine leg was up, easy for Rahane to help it down to the fine leg boundary
shortish and outside off, once more Rahane jumps down the track shuffling towards the leg side to make more room and chops it towards extra cover for four
full toss and that is whipped towards deep square leg for a single
one more to long-off to end the over
helped towards long-off for a single, nine off the over already with minimal risk
pushed off the front foot towards cover for a single
short of length ball on offstump, Rahane works it against the spin behind square leg to get a single that reaches his fifty
pitched up and spinning away, well outside off, Rahane reaches across and places that through point for four
Rahul drops it short, whipped towards midwicket
on the pads, helped along towards a fine leg, Ganguly has plenty to do, batsmen have time to take three
flighted on leg stump, helped to mid-on
on middle and leg, worked towards square leg
pitched up and that is sliced over cover point by Rahane, he skips down the ground before launching that one
helped along to long-on for a comfortable single
down the leg side
driven towards long-on for a couple, might have been tight if the throw had been more accurate
short from Nehra, on leg stump, Hodge is cramped by that, drops the ball towards square leg and picks up a single
pitched up, and this is a classic drive from Hodge, leans into it as he sends the ball towards sweeper cover
short of length ball on middle and off, defended to the off side by Hodge

Nehra has got the big breakthrough, a yorker from just outside off, Watson looks to squeeze this one out, but can only edge it on to the stumps, much needed wicket this, Watson was threatening to take this away from Pune, he's already provided a solid platform
pitched up and just outside off, driven towards long-off for a single
length ball on the pads, easy to dispatch that one, Rahane glances that towards fine leg for four, with fine leg up that really is a poor delivery from Nehra
Mathews switches to over the wicket, responds with a yorker that Watson can't put away, outside off and through to the keeper
murder, Watson is unstoppable here, pitched up and just outside off, that is absolutely hammered by Watson towards long-off for four, serious power
low full toss from round the wicket, 130.6kph, thumped back towards the bowler
full toss on middle and off, 127kph, worked towards square leg by Rahane
worked towards midwicket, Rahane races back for two

Mathews returns as Pune continue to switch the bowling around, first ball is driven towards wide long-off, where there is another misfield, Majumdar this time, not for four though, gives away one extra run
more powerful biffing from Watson, this time towards long-off where Murali Kartik misfields, falls over the ball to let it through for four
the fifty comes up with a monstrous hit over midwicket for six, a friendly length delivery, Watson pulverises it, 50 off only 26 deliveries
a low full toss slanting down the leg side, all to easy for Watson, whips it towards deep backward square leg for four
length ball, Watson edges this onto his pad, again he was looking to launch that out of the ground
short of length ball 123kph ball, slapped back towards the bowler, Watson can't time it
Ryder starts with a length ball on the pads, pushed to the leg side for a single
another single to long-off to end the over
full toss outside off, driven towards long-off, bowler gets away with that one
short of length ball angling in towards the pad, clipped behind square leg
pitched up, drilled towards long-on for a single
length ball is driven towards long-off for a single
short of length on off stump, defended towards mid-on, Ganguly shows his football skills as he fields
gets on his toes and drives that towards sweeper cover for a single
short from Rahul, and he's be glad that didn't disappear over the rope, Watson rarely misses those, he mishits it towards long-on, no mistake from Smith this time, keeping the batsman to a single
outside off, not too much width but enough for Watson to show he's not all about brute force, carves it behind backward point for four, superb placement there
a dive from Rahane saves him as he attempts a tight second, Watson had worked it to midwicket, the ball hadn't gone too far past the inner circle, Rahane has to hurry

stop press! Steve Smith has misfielded, lets it through for four, that was short from Rahul, Watson slammed it along the gorund towards long-on, Smith got to the ball in time but makes a hash of the fielding effort, slightly over ran it actually
full from Kartik, punched towards the bowler
this time he connects exactly as he wanted, that was a poor delivery, a full toss and that is dispatched a long way over midwicket for six more, ominous this

a Watson trademark, a bit of flight from Kartik and well outside off, Watson flat-bats that with immense power over long-on, Watson didn't connect as well as he would have liked but still had enough to beat Smith who was patrolling the boundary
on the pads once more, helped to midwicket for a single this time
length ball on leg stump, clipped towards deep midwicket
full toss on off stump, whipped towards square leg by Watson
full and on the pads, driven along the ground towards long-on

length again, heading for middle and off, played with very soft hands, the ball just rolls past the inner circle, giving Ganguly more work to do, the batsmen pinch two again, Ganguly doesn't collect the ball cleanly
length ball just outside off, 'Two, two, two," called Rahane as he drove that towards Ganguly at deep midwicket
a yorker from Mathews is squeezed out towards cover
short of length ball outside off, stays a touch low, Rahane was looking to hammer that through the off, edges it, luckily for him not on to the stumps, Uthappa stops that to his left
that was too full for Watson, he was looking to club that over the bowler's head but it ended up almost a sa yorker, Watson couldn't get under it and the ball rolls towards the bowler
pitched up, punched back towards the bowler
length ball pitching around off, watchfully defended towards cover point for a single
pitches it this time, driven inside-out along the ground towards long-off, batsmen scamper back for the second
another low full toss, on middle stump, eased towards long-on for a single
a loopy low full toss on legstump, gets away with it, pushed towards mid-on
shorter from Mathews, and well outside off, Watson doesn't care as he muscles that wide of long-on for four more
back of a length from Mathews, punched back to the bowler
another length ball, punched towards cover off the front foot by Watson
a confident push towards mid-off for a single
length ball, Rahane looks to push that through off but is struck on the front as he misses
length ball from Mathews, edged towards gully by Watson
short of length and stays a bit low, Rahane jumps as he defends that down the pitch
on the pads this time, wonderfully stroke from Rahane, waits for it and just helps it along towards deep backward square leg for four, all about timing that
short of length and just outside off, defended towards the bowler
short of length and on middle and leg, pushed towards mid-on for a single
Boom! Watson slams it over midwicket for six, that was a short of length and sat up for Watto, thanks he said as he slugged it powerfully to one of his favourite areas
length ball on off stump, defended towards point
short of length and outside off, another lofted shot, off the back foot and over cover for four more
short of length and just outside off, defended towards the off side
short of length and angling across, guided down towards third man

superb catch from Uthappa, especially as he's a part-time keeper, Dravid is gone, he wanted to launch that over the off side, but gets an outside edge, Uthappa dives to his right and takes a low one-handed catch
cracked towards point from the crease by Dravid
back of a length ball angling across Dravid, who gets on his toes and looks to whip the ball towards square leg but is beaten and the ball just goes over the stumps
inside-out from Rahane, a lofted drive over cover, he's played that stroke well this tournament, skipping beyond leg and gets his first boundary
on the pads this time, clipped to square leg for one more
too wide outside off, short as well, Dravid shifts to his backfoot and carves that behind backward point for four, this outfield is pretty quick
pitched up once more, on middle and off, Dravid pushes it towards mid-off off the back foot
pitched up and spinning away outside off, pushed towards mid-off for a single
Rahul Sharma starts with a length ball on middle and leg, defended to the right of the bowler
shorter this time and angling in towards the pads, guided behind backward square leg
short of length and just outside off, Dravid opens the face and pushes the ball towards point, another dot ball
pushed towards cover by Dravid
a bit of an edge as the ball flies down towards third man for a single, Rahane off the mark
defended more confidently this time by Dravid, towards bcakward point

ooh, that was so close to being bowled, Bhuvneshwar  gets the ball to nip in a hint off a back of a length, Dravid pokes at it and gets an inside edge, that sails over the stumps and past the keeper for four
defended towards midwicket, Rahane wanted the single which would get him off the mark, Dravid sends him back, wisely
sticks to the leg stump line, helped down to fine leg
fuller this time and on the pads once more, effortlessly clipped towards midwicket for four
short of length and heading for leg stump, looks to whip it to the leg side but doesn't connect
shortish and very wide, slapped towards backward point where Steven Smith dives to make a stop
short of length and outside off, pushed towards cover from the crease
nudged towards square leg for a single
too wide outside off, Dravid chops that past point off the back foot and he gets to 400 runs in this tournament
way down the leg side, wide past the keeper and towards the short fine leg
length ball is again defended off the front foot towards the bowler
blocked off the front foot by Rahane
on the pads, worked towards midwicket
defends the first ball of the innings to the off side off the front foot
length ball angling in, thick outside edge past the keeper for four, Rajasthan don't care, they have won by 45 runs and move to 14 points to stay in the race
Nehra shuffles across and looks to pull that towards square leg but misses, struck on the pad outside off
whips a full ball towards midwicket, lands short of the fielder there, Nehra rushes back for the second, not often I will get to type that phrase
scythed towards sweeper cover for a single
length ball on middle and leg, batsman backs away and drives to long-off
short of length ball on leg stump, worked towards the cover
again it is full, again it is between the batsman and leg stump, again the batsman misses, through to the keeper
Tait aiming for the blockhole, 142 kph, squeezed out towards point
full ball from Tait, whipped towards midwicket
a yorker from Tait, between the batsman and leg stump
a short ball is helped towards third man
full ball, worked towards midwicket

out of the world fielding here! another slower on from Watson, pitched up and that is slammed towards Botha at long-off, Botha jumps towards the rope to collect that one, as Botha lands he realises he is going to go over the boundary, Botha looks to see that Rahane is there at long-off and he lobs the ball towards him, Rahane is at least 20 yards away but he has a simple catch to take, ridiculously good that, Rahan was grinning even before he took that catch
short of length and outside off, slashed towards cover
slower one outside off, Kartik steers it to sweeper cover for one
short of length ball and angling down leg, off the pads towards square leg

another one gone, Watson slips in the back of the hand slower one, pitched up, Mathews wanted to hammer that over long-on, can only find Rahane at long-on, Pune lose their eighth, this game will be quite handy for Rajasthan's net run-rate
drives this towards long-on for a single
a full toss outside off and that is slashed towards deep point for a single
Mathews didn't have much of a clue about that, 143kph from Tait, full and following Mathews, somehow Mathews gets his bat on it, bit of an edge towards third man
short of length ball on middle stump, drops it towards square leg
loud appeal for lbw from Tait, that was going on to hit but that pitched outside off
too good and too quick from Tait, 146kph and full, just moving away a touch, Bhuvneshar is stuck on the crease as he looks to keep that out, he can't and off stump is on the ground
Tait starts with a short of length ball outside off, slapped towards sweeper cover
legcutter from Binny once more, this one turns past the outside edge after pitching short of a length around off, the batsman is beaten
chopped towards backward point for one more
driven towards sweeper cover for a single

innovative from Mathews, moves across the stumps and paddles that from off stump, over Tait at short fine leg, Tait has to put in a dive after chasing after that one, it was a slower legspinner from Binny
short and sits up, Mathews should have dispatched that for four, it takes longer than he expects, he can only slug it towards wide long-on for two
short of length and just outside off, tucked towards square leg
slugged towards wide long-on once more, a diving stop from Rahane prevents the boundary
a poor delivery there, a rare lapse from Botha today, high full toss is slammed wide of long-on for four
spinning in towards the leg stump, Mathews is surprised by the amount of turn, defended to the off side
full ball is clipped by Bhuneswar towards long-on
another one bites the dust, a flat, length ball from Botha is launched towards long-on, Hodge comes in from the boundary and takes a low catch to dismiss Smith
another ugly swipe from Smith, its a short of length ball and that is sent towards long-on
not very elegant this time from Smith, looking to mow this over midwicket, that was down the leg side, gets a thick bottom edge past short fine leg
length ball on off and middle, Mathews skips towards leg and drops the ball towards point, a tight run is taken, the throw hits Mathews' bat as he completes the single
helped along with the angle towards square leg
follows the batsman down the leg side, Smith looks to swipe it towards midwicket but misses
Trivedi bowls his third over in a row, no one bowled a three-over spell for Pune, slower ball, defended off the back foot towards cover
length ball on off stump, Mathews moves across and tucks it behind square leg
length ball outside off, Smith lofts it towards mid-off, mistimed by him but that means it doesn't carry all the way to long-off
length ball angling in and another single towards long-on
fuller and that is drilled towards long-on, Smith charges down to get to the pitch
length again, on off stump, Mathews goes deep in the crease and works it to square leg
length ball just outside off, defended towards midwicket
lovely, insouciant from Smith, short of length ball from Trivedi and just outside off, Smith moves towards leg and then opens the face to steer the ball past short third man for four
shortish from Trivedi, helped towards deep backward square leg
short of length ball, Smith charges out and guides the ball towards sweeper cover
length ball on off stump, clipped towards midwicket
short of length and on leg stump, pushed between midwicket and long-on by Smith
short of length and outside off, slapped towards backward point by Smith
driven along the ground to long-on for a single to end the over
not as elegant this time, looking to tuck the ball to the leg side, leading edge sends it to the off
length ball well outside off, elegantly driven by Smith, that's an effortless boundary from him, all about timing there as he sends the ball to the sweeper cover boundary
full ball is whipped towards deep square leg, both batsmen are quick between the stumps, they get back for the second
pitched up and just outside off, driven towards long-on for a single

another one down for Pune, Ferguson is gone now, he again moved across the stumps, Botha sends it flat and towards middle and leg, Ferguson has to adjust late since he has gone too far across, can't get his front leg out of the way quick enough, struck on the pad and that's lbw
helped towards midwicket for a single to end the over
short of length ball again, defended to the off side from the crease
short of length and well outside off, pulled towards deep midwicket
similar length and closer to the stumps, clipped to midwicket
short of length and outside off, opens the face to guide that towards third man
down the leg side, deftly guided towards fine leg, Tait can't get there to stop it from reaching the rope
pitched up and that is eased towards long-off for a single
a hit-me delivery, short and heading down leg, Ferguson needed to decide whether he wants to dispatch that for a boundary, instead he gets it towards deep backward square leg
gives some width, pushed towards cover for a single
outside off, looks to smash that off the back foot towards midwicket, doesn't connect and the keeper doesn't collect, signalled byes, there was a loud shot as he looks to play that shot
nudged towards midwicket for a single
spins in from short of a length, helped behind square leg
once more he walks across, this time he tucks it towards deep backward square leg, where the fielder needs two attempts to ensure the ball doesn't reach the rope
length ball on off stump, Ferguson has moved across a touch to target the big gap on the leg side, stylishly played towards midwicket for four
fuller and just outside off, driven towards extra cover
the free-hit is wasted, as Ferguson looks to launch the ball into orbit beyond midwicket but he can't connect on the short of length ball outside off
full and wide, that is driven towards sweeper cover, Tait has overstepped
similar length and closer to off, shuffles across and clips it towards square leg
short of a length and just outside off, worked towards mid-on
ends the spell with a dot ball, full and it is driven back towards Chandila, who ends with 4 for 13
pitched up, eased towards long-on for a single
short of a length and outside off, pushed towards midwicket
getting it to bounce a bit, off a length and that is worked towards square leg
length ball, pushed back towards the bowler this time
Chandila starts his final over, driven towards long-off for a couple
this time it is wider, this time Smith connects, 129kph from Tait, and Smith cracks it behind point for four more
back of a length and outside off, wants to slap that through the off, misses
more defence, off the back foot this time, Tait not providing any width
short of length again, on middle stump, Tait grunts with the effort, 145kph, defended to the off side
similar length and closer to off, defended towards backward point for a single this time
short of a length and outside off, steered down to third man for two
defends it to the off side

a fourth for Chandila! this is what dreams are made of, again an innocuous delivery, tentatively played by Majumdar, it was on a length, and struck high on Majumdar's bat and looped back to the bowler, who completes a simple catch, 4 for 9 now for Chandila, who'd have thunk it.
tossed up on middle stumped, defended
gets away with a delivery down the leg side, should have been called a wide, perhaps the umpire thought that hit the pads
flighted again, driven crisply towards long-on for a single
given some air, that is defended towards cover
short of length and just outside off, Majumdar looks to carve it through cover, gets a thick edge past the keeper and fine of third man for four
short of length and around off, defended towards the bowler
a good length ball angling in, lovely stroke that, he was off the ground as he flicked that towards midwicket, gets enough power on it and the placement is perfect as well,

there'a communication breakdown there, nearly a run-out but the throws hits the Majumdar's legs after  he is slow to respond to the call for a single, Ferguson had played that towards mid-on and set off
angling in, Ferguson wants to glance that but misses, off the pads and towards the keeper
a leading edge towards the off side as he looks to play it to the leg side
short from Chandila, Ferguson gets back and cracks it past cover for four

outside off this time, defended back to the bowler, Chandila doesn't really try to turn the ball much, his left-arm isn't doing much as he delivers, he has a relaxed almost casual action as he sends that ball in
defended back to the bowler this time
defended off the front foot to the off side

a hat-trick for Chandila, the first one of the season, length ball outside off, Uthappa looking to drive that through the off, is dragged forward as he tries the shot, he's beaten and his back foot is out of the crease, Sreevats is on to complete the job, Uthappa's disappointing season continues, Chandila, on the other hand, is ecstatic though, setting off on a fist-pumping celebratory run
just outside off, Uthappa plays it from the crease, steered towards backward point
lovely straight hit from Uthappa, a short of length ball, is lofted on-the-up and over the bowler's head, no attempt to thrash that more about timing
Majumdar looks to drive from the crease, outside edge towards third man
short of length and outside off, Uthappa opens the face and guides the ball towards third man for a single
more watchfulness from Uthappa, back of a length ball on the stumps, blocked towards the bowler
slides down the leg side, a free run for Pune
full ball from Watson to start, defended by Uthappa

is that another one? another on leg stump, Ganguly stepped forward and looks to nudge it to the leg side, off the bat and on to the pad, bouncing to the keeper, Ganguly overbalances, the keeper is quick to take off the bails and just beats Ganguly's attempt to get back, terrific start for Rajasthan, the spinner whose name Dravid couldn't recall has removed both openers in the first over

Jesse Ryder is gone, his seventh single-digit score in 10 games, he gets under one from Chandila, and lofts it high, doesn't carry very far, Watson pedals back from mid-on and settles under it, Chandila's first wicket of the season, I'm waiting for a renewed barrage of where-is-Tamim mails
on leg stump, flicked to square leg
a vociferous multi-stage appeal for lbw as Ganguly is struck on the knee roll in front of middle and off, Ganguly seemed in danger there but the umpire felt that pitched outside leg, tight call that
fuller and again outside leg, eased towards wide long-on, Chandila not giving the ball too much of a rip here
starts with a short of length ball on the pads, clipped behind square leg
